### Speculating about the Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/speculating-about-christ
Passage: John 7:25-31
Points:
- Religious leaders opposed Jesus' Sabbath healings because they considered non-emergency actions unlawful on the Sabbath.
- By healing on the Sabbath, Jesus claimed divine authority to rightly interpret and apply God's law.
- The people in the temple questioned whether the leaders secretly believed Jesus was the Messiah since they let Him teach openly.
- Many assumed Jesus could not be the Christ because they knew His family origins in Galilee rather than an obscure, sudden arrival.
- Jesus revealed that while they recognized His earthly background, they did not truly know God who sent Him.
- Christians are reminded that the Sabbath is designed for our benefit and should include acts of mercy and doing good.
